```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r voronoi-prep}
# Transform everything to UTM 32N
baseMap_utm  <- st_transform(baseMap, 25832)
inex_benches <- st_transform(inex_benches, 25832)

# Keep only benches with a definite inclusive/exclusionary label
benches_marked <- dplyr::filter(inex_benches, !is.na(is_inclusive))


cat(sprintf(
  "Marked benches: %d total | %d inclusive | %d exclusionary\n",
  nrow(benches_marked),
  sum(benches_marked$is_inclusive == "inclusive"),
  sum(benches_marked$is_inclusive == "exclusive")
))
```

```{r voronoi-polygons}
voronoi_raw <- benches_marked %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_voronoi() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_intersection(st_make_valid(baseMap_utm))

voronoi_labelled <- voronoi_raw %>%
  st_join(benches_marked["is_inclusive"], join = st_nearest_feature) %>%
  mutate(
    area_m2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)),
    category = ifelse(is_inclusive == "inclusive", "Inclusive", "Exclusive")
  )
```

```{r voronoi-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
theme_ppt <- theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = voronoi_labelled, aes(fill = category),
          colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = baseMap_utm, fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = benches_marked, aes(colour = is_inclusive), size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Inclusive" = "forestgreen", "Exclusive" = "#f06292"),
                    name = "Service area") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("inclusive" = "darkgreen", "exclusive" = "#c2185b")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                             override.aes = list(alpha = 0.85, size = 5))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Who Does Each Bench Serve? (Aarhus Municipality, Denmark)",
    subtitle = "Voronoi Diagram - Each region shows the area served by its nearest bench"
  ) +
  theme_ppt

p_load(mapview)
mapview(voronoi_labelled, zcol = "category")
```

```{r voronoi-summary}
voronoi_labelled %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    mean_m2   = round(mean(area_m2)),
    median_m2 = round(median(area_m2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()
```



```{r voronoi-polygons}
# Use ALL benches including NA
voronoi_raw <- inex_benches %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_voronoi() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_intersection(st_make_valid(baseMap_utm))

voronoi_labelled <- voronoi_raw %>%
  st_join(inex_benches["is_inclusive"], join = st_nearest_feature) %>%
  mutate(
    area_m2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)),
    category = case_when(
      is_inclusive == "inclusive" ~ "Inclusive",
      is_inclusive == "exclusive" ~ "Exclusive",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )
```

```{r voronoi-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
theme_ppt <- theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title  = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = voronoi_labelled, aes(fill = category),
          colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = baseMap_utm, fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = inex_benches, aes(colour = is_inclusive), size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Inclusive" = "forestgreen", "Exclusive" = "red3", "Unknown" = "grey70"),
    name = "Service area"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("inclusive" = "darkgreen", "exclusive" = "darkred"),
    na.value = "grey50"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                             override.aes = list(alpha = 0.85, size = 5))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Who Does Each Bench Serve? (Aarhus Municipality, Denmark)",
    subtitle = "Voronoi Diagram - Each region shows the area served by its nearest bench"
  ) +
  theme_ppt
```

```{r voronoi-interactive}
mapview(voronoi_labelled, zcol = "category",
        col.regions = c("Exclusionary" = "red3", "Inclusive" = "forestgreen", "Unknown" = "grey70"),
        layer.name = "Service area") +
mapview(inex_benches, zcol = "is_inclusive",
        col.regions = c("exclusionary" = "darkred", "inclusive" = "darkgreen"),
        na.color = "grey50",
        cex = 3, layer.name = "Benches")
```
